# Variable `USERADD_DEPENDS`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies a list of recipes that create users / groups (via USERADD_PARAM / GROUPADD_PARAM) which a recipe depends upon. This ensures that those users / groups are available when building a recipe.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-USERADD_DEPENDS
